scripts.init:unix: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../server && python3 -m venv venv && . ./venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m model.train
scripts.init:win: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd ../server && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m model.train
scripts.app:win: start /B vite && cd ../server && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
